INSERT INTO `stock_forecast_prediction` (`run_id`, `code`, `market`, `forecast_date`, `adjustflag`, `horizon_days`, `predicted_daily_return`, `predicted_cumulative_return`, `target15_probability`, `confidence`, `forecast_score`, `analog_count`, `evaluation_status`) VALUES
(#{item.runId}, #{item.code}, #{item.market}, #{item.forecastDate}, #{item.adjustFlag}, #{item.horizonDays}, #{item.predictedDailyReturn}, #{item.predictedCumulativeReturn}, #{item.target15Probability}, #{item.confidence}, #{item.forecastScore}, #{item.analogCount}, #{item.evaluationStatus})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `predicted_daily_return`=VALUES(`predicted_daily_return`), `predicted_cumulative_return`=VALUES(`predicted_cumulative_return`), `target15_probability`=VALUES(`target15_probability`), `confidence`=VALUES(`confidence`), `forecast_score`=VALUES(`forecast_score`), `analog_count`=VALUES(`analog_count`)
mapper.select: SELECT `id`, `forecast_date` AS `forecastDate`, `adjustflag` AS `adjustFlag`, `source_latest_date` AS `sourceLatestDate`, `model_version` AS `modelVersion`, `stock_count` AS `stockCount`, `created_at` AS `createdAt` FROM `stock_forecast_run` WHERE `adjustflag` = #{adjustFlag} ORDER BY `id` DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT `id`, `forecast_date` AS `forecastDate`, `adjustflag` AS `adjustFlag`, `source_latest_date` AS `sourceLatestDate`, `model_version` AS `modelVersion`, `stock_count` AS `stockCount`, `created_at` AS `createdAt` FROM `stock_forecast_run` WHERE `id` = #{runId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `stock_forecast_prediction` f20 LEFT JOIN `stock_info` i ON i.`code` = f20.`code` AND i.`exchange` = f20.`market`

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ) AS `rank`, f20.`code`, i.`name`, i.`market`, i.`exchange`, i.`board`, i.`industry`, f20.`forecast_date` AS `forecastDate`, f20.`run_id` AS `runId`, f20.`forecast_score` AS `score20`, f5.`predicted_cumulative_return` AS `predictedCum5`, f10.`predicted_cumulative_return` AS `predictedCum10`, f15.`predicted_cumulative_return` AS `predictedCum15`, f20.`predicted_cumulative_return` AS `predictedCum20`, f20.`target15_probability` AS `probability20`, f20.`confidence` AS `confidence20`, f20.`analog_count` AS `analogCount20`, f20.`actual_cumulative_return` AS `actualCum20`, f20.`prediction_error` AS `error20`, f20.`evaluation_status` AS `status20` FROM `stock_forecast_prediction` f20 LEFT JOIN `stock_forecast_prediction` f5 ON f5.`run_id`=f20.`run_id` AND f5.`code`=f20.`code` AND f5.`market`=f20.`market` AND f5.`horizon_days`=5 LEFT JOIN `stock_forecast_prediction` f10 ON f10.`run_id`=f20.`run_id` AND f10.`code`=f20.`code` AND f10.`market`=f20.`market` AND f10.`horizon_days`=10 LEFT JOIN `stock_forecast_prediction` f15 ON f15.`run_id`=f20.`run_id` AND f15.`code`=f20.`code` AND f15.`market`=f20.`market` AND f15.`horizon_days`=15 LEFT JOIN `stock_info` i ON i.`code`=f20.`code` AND i.`exchange`=f20.`market`
ORDER BY LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.`code`, i.`name`, p.`market`, i.`exchange`, i.`board`, i.`industry`, p.`forecast_date` AS `forecastDate`, p.`run_id` AS `runId`, p.`horizon_days` AS `horizonDays`, p.`actual_target_date` AS `actualTargetDate`, p.`predicted_daily_return` AS `predictedDailyReturn`, p.`predicted_cumulative_return` AS `predictedCumulativeReturn`, p.`target15_probability` AS `target15Probability`, p.`confidence`, p.`forecast_score` AS `forecastScore`, p.`actual_daily_return` AS `actualDailyReturn`, p.`actual_cumulative_return` AS `actualCumulativeReturn`, p.`prediction_error` AS `predictionError`, p.`evaluation_status` AS `evaluationStatus` FROM `stock_forecast_prediction` p LEFT JOIN `stock_info` i ON i.`code`=p.`code` AND i.`exchange`=p.`market` WHERE p.`run_id` = #{runId} AND p.`code` = #{code} ORDER BY p.`horizon_days`

SELECT `run_id` AS `runId`, `code`, `market`, `forecast_date` AS `forecastDate`, `adjustflag` AS `adjustFlag`, `horizon_days` AS `horizonDays`, `predicted_daily_return` AS `predictedDailyReturn`, `predicted_cumulative_return` AS `predictedCumulativeReturn`, `target15_probability` AS `target15Probability`, `confidence`, `forecast_score` AS `forecastScore`, `analog_count` AS `analogCount`, `actual_target_date` AS `actualTargetDate`, `actual_daily_return` AS `actualDailyReturn`, `actual_cumulative_return` AS `actualCumulativeReturn`, `prediction_error` AS `predictionError`, `evaluation_status` AS `evaluationStatus`, `evaluated_at` AS `evaluatedAt` FROM `stock_forecast_prediction` WHERE `run_id` = #{runId} ORDER BY `code`, `market`, `horizon_days`
